purpose: test whether a polynomial-size K3 three-local affine-hull relaxation can conservatively eliminate wrong final-stage classes for the already-spent ABCD Pythia-14M target without enumerating the 24 K3 histories
target_selection: already-spent fixed ABCD target used by prior K3, inverse, and forward-reachable diagnostics
primary_feasible_upper_bound_source: frozen K3 nearest history for the same spent ABCD target from run 33267599644
affine_relaxation_scope: drop all box and nonnegativity constraints; retain triple simplex, pair-triple marginal consistency, and candidate-last pair equalities
affine_lower_bound_theorem: every discrete K3 chronology ending in candidate stage j lies in the candidate-j affine set, so distance from the target to that affine set is a lower bound on the best discrete K3 error among histories ending in j
elimination_rule: candidate last stage j is certified impossible for the K3 nearest-history problem only if affine_lower_bound_j > feasible_upper_bound_error + numerical_lower_bound_guard
strong_success_requires: target endpoint hash exactly replays ABCD
frozen BACD feasible upper-bound error reproduces within tolerance
all four affine KKT solves satisfy frozen residual tolerances
A, B, and C are all eliminated
promising_partial_requires: at least one of A/B/C is certified impossible while D remains feasible
interpretation_scope: tests scalable search/certification geometry only inside the degree-three truncated endpoint model; it does not yet use the successful active final-stage transition map and cannot by itself claim recovery of the true ABCD history
next_step_if_strong_success: extend the same affine lower-bound machinery to fixed suffix constraints and test certified branch-and-bound reconstruction of the frozen K3 nearest history before coupling it to active transitions
next_step_if_partial: retain the affine bounds as pruning machinery and add a frozen active-transition tangent correction on spent data
next_step_if_zero_wrong_stages_eliminate: declare the pure K3 affine hull too loose for pruning and move directly to an active-transition tangent or secant relaxation; do not expose heldout codebooks
